create_tokenizer_fastspeech2_conformer: create a FastSpeech2ConformerTokenizer instance from a vocab.json file with custom special tokens
tokenize_text_phonemize: tokenize english text into phonemes using g2p_en with FastSpeech2ConformerTokenizer
convert_tokens_to_ids: convert a list of phoneme tokens to their corresponding integer vocab ids
convert_ids_to_tokens: convert a list of integer vocab ids back to their corresponding phoneme tokens
save_tokenizer_vocabulary: save the FastSpeech2ConformerTokenizer vocabulary to a directory as a json file
